questions.statement: Choose the correct word: "Last Saturday I ___ to the park with my father."
questions.context: Repaso del sexto periodo en el que los estudiantes describen su fin de semana.

options.feedback: go is the present form; the words Last Saturday place the action in the past.
went is the irregular past simple of go, and the sentence talks about an action that already happened.
am going is the present continuous and describes an action in progress, not something that already happened.
will go expresses a plan or a future prediction, and the sentence already places the action in the past.

questions.explanation: El indicio de tiempo es lo que decide el verbo, no el sentido de la oracion. Last Saturday, yesterday y last night obligan al pasado simple, y entre las formas del pasado el verbo to go es irregular, por eso se memoriza como went y no como goed.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "I eat an apple and a banana for snack every day." How many fruits does the child eat?
questions.context: Ejercicio de repaso de los snacks y la comida del recreo.

options.feedback: One would be the answer if the text mentioned a single type of fruit.
The text names two different fruits, an apple and a banana.
Three would require a third food in the list, and the sentence only lists two.
Four goes beyond what the text enumerates, which is limited to two fruits for the snack.

questions.explanation: Contar elementos de una enumeracion escrita es una habilidad de comprension lectora basica y muy usada en las pruebas de grado tercero. La clave esta en identificar la conjunction and, que anuncia que la lista sigue y que hay un elemento mas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: It is afternoon now and the sun is still up. Choose the better question for your brother.
questions.context: Repaso de la hora en que empiezan las actividades de la tarde.

options.text: What time do you go to bed?
options.feedback: That question is asked at night, at the end of the day, and not in the afternoon with the sun still up.
What time is it now asks for the current hour, which is exactly what the student wants to know in the afternoon.
That question is asked in the morning to find out the time of waking up, and not at noon.
That question asks for a length of time in hours, and not for the time of day at this moment.

questions.explanation: Repetir la palabra tiempo en ingles no significa que todas las preguntas sean equivalentes: What time is it pide la hora, When pregunta el momento y How long pide una duracion. Diferenciar esos tres usos evita que el estudiante responda con una informacion que no fue solicitada.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "My brother goes to school at seven and comes home at four." How many hours is he at school?
questions.context: Lectura de un texto sobre las partes del dia en la rutina de una familia.

options.feedback: Two hours do not correspond to the difference between seven and four.
From 7:00 to 16:00 there are nine hours, which is how long the school day in the text lasts.
Twenty-four hours is a full day and not the time the brother spends at school.
Eleven would be the count from midnight to eleven, which is another way of measuring the same schedule.

questions.explanation: Resolver problemas de reloj convierte un texto en un calculo. La estrategia es restar la hora de llegada a la hora de salida, y en este caso da 16 - 7 = 9. La opcion de once horas es el error tipico cuando el estudiante cuenta el tiempo desde medianoche en lugar de calcular la duracion real.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct preposition: "My English class starts ___ eight o'clock and ends ___ twelve."
questions.context: Repaso de las preposiciones de tiempo en las expresiones de la vida diaria.

options.feedback: Exact hours are preceded by at, both at eight and at twelve.
in is used with broader expressions like in the morning, not with an exact hour like eight.
on is used with days and dates, like on Monday, and not with hours of the clock.
to indicates destination or the interval between two points, and does not introduce the starting hour of a class.

questions.explanation: La preposicion de tiempo depende de la granularidad del dato: at para horas exactas, in para periodos amplios como la manana o la tarde y on para dias y fechas. En el repaso del sexto periodo los estudiantes ya deben aplicar esa tabla a dos espacios en la misma oracion.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Ejercicio de repaso sobre los animales en la granja de la escuela.

options.feedback: The hen lays eggs and does not produce milk.
The cow is the animal from which we get the milk we drink.
The horse is used for riding and for transport, not for producing milk.
The sheep gives wool and meat, and its milk is not the daily food the exercise talks about.

questions.explanation: Asociar un animal con su producto es el contenido principal de esta unidad de repaso: la gallina da huevos, la oveja da lana y la vaca da leche. Este tipo de emparejamiento de vocabulario aparece con frecuencia en las pruebas de grado tercero porque comprueba comprension activa y no solo reconocimiento.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Look at the sentence: "___ you ever eaten sushi?" Which auxiliary makes the question correct?
questions.context: Repaso de las preguntas de experiencia con el verbo have.

options.feedback: are combines with a participle like eaten and is used with the verb to be, not with the verb to have.
haveever forms the present perfect with the participle eaten, which is the structure the exercise asks for.
do is used for the present simple, like Do you like sushi, and not for a participle.
did forms the interrogative past simple and needs the base verb, not the form eaten.

questions.explanation: La presencia de un participio como eaten revela que la oracion pide el presente perfecto. El auxiliar que acompaña al participio es have, y el orden correcto es have you ever eaten. Reconocer la forma del participio es la estrategia mas segura para escoger el auxiliar en preguntas de este tipo.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "There are seven pencils and three erasers on my desk." How many objects are on the desk in total?
questions.context: Prueba final de repaso del periodo con preguntas sobre el numero y la cantidad.

options.feedback: Ten would be the total if the numbers were seven and three, but the two groups have to be added.
Nine corresponds only to the pencils plus two extra, and it does not add the three erasers.

options.text: Seven plus three, ten in total
options.feedback: 7 + 3 = 10, and the option shows the operation that justifies the total.
Three is only the number of erasers and leaves out the group of seven pencils.

questions.explanation: Mostrar la operacion en la respuesta es una buena estrategia de comprension numerica: permite al docente ver el procedimiento y no solo el resultado. Cuando un total resulta ser mas de diez, conviene expresar la cuenta en dos pasos, siete y luego tres, para evitar errores de suma mental.
questions.subject: ingles
